parking-jam.title: Parking Jam: Untangle the Puzzle and Free the Cars
parking-jam.slogan: Challenge Your Logic in Parking Jam
parking-jam.description: Parking Jam is a challenging puzzle game where you untangle a crowded parking lot one car at a time. Use your logic and problem-solving skills to move vehicles in the correct order, clearing the way without causing chaos. With each level, tackle increasingly complex puzzles filled with more cars and tricky obstacles. Play Parking Jam now and test your skills!
